---
name: Feature request / Enhancement
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the Nexus ecosystem
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alignment with Nexus Vision & Roadmap
How does this fit into the layered architecture, specific phase (0-4), or ecosystem repo (nexus-daemon, novanet, etc.)? Reference relevant docs if possible.

## Alternatives considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional context
Add any other context, mockups, diagrams (Mermaid preferred), or examples here.

**Nuances / Implications / Edge cases** (encouraged):
- Technical trade-offs (e.g., mesh latency vs. real-time decisions)
- Privacy or security considerations
- Impact on self-improving agents or emergence
- Hardware / deployment implications (Hannover pilots or global scale)
- Governance or humanistic alignment aspects

## Would you be willing to contribute?
- [ ] Yes, I can work on a PR
- [ ] I can help with testing / feedback
- [ ] Documentation or creative aspects

---

*We value depth and context in proposals — it helps the whole ecosystem evolve coherently.*
